question: Over which initial energies, RF phases, azimuths and tangential velocity directions does the rotating octupole outperform the standing-wave octupole?
field_source: Verified FEM-derived N48 reconstructions h35_P4 and h50_P4; no new FEM solve
legacy_exclusion: V1/V2 full-RF classifications at labels 250 V excluded: their trajectory RHS omitted the 250 V multiplication

adaptive_refinement.rule: Insert midpoint energies only in sampled retained/escaped brackets; add a dynamics midpoint only when max-radius model difference changes by at least 0.75 mm, RMS model difference by at least 0.5 mm, a same-model slow radial period changes by over 25%, or escape time changes materially near the aperture. Probe 0.5 eV only at 1-eV model discordances, 3.5 eV at 3-eV discordance/near-aperture starts, and 4 eV only after a 3.5-eV discordance or 7.5-mm excursion. Never interpolate uncalculated outcomes.
adaptive_refinement.round3_unrun_candidates: Other round-3 orbital-dynamics candidates were not submitted; see adaptive_round3_jobs.json and adaptive_round3_boundary_jobs.json

matched_leading_pseudopotential_protocol.note: Matches leading term at the 0.5-mm reference; does not make complete multipole pseudopotentials exactly equal

solver.event: terminal outward crossing of r=8 mm
solver.checkpoint: append-only fsync trajectory_checkpoint.jsonl plus atomic per-job state every 300 RF
solver.reused_v3_trace_policy: truncate shared longer V3 files at each row horizon before diagnostics

resources.deadline_guard: stop worker segments with >=240 s deadline remaining; submit no new integration stage with <120 s remaining

interpretation.retained: survived through the finite 1000-RF observation horizon
interpretation.retained_not: not evidence for a permanently stable orbit
interpretation.fraction: descriptive fraction of the deliberately designed matched grid, not a population probability
interpretation.escape_time: first outward crossing; retained cases are right-censored at the observation horizon
